messages:
sam: quick alert — customer onboarding sample app failing on route creation. REST POST returns 201 but python-sdk client returns 422 (validation: missing model_variant). Also observed duplicate routes when infra returned 500. anyone familiar with py sdk parity gaps?
aj: do you have the exact payloads/snippets? sounds like param naming/serialization mismatch + retry behavior.
sam: yep repro below. REST (works):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/routes \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  -d '{"name":"onboard-test","model":"gpt-open-3","model_variant":"v2","timeout":30}'
```
Python SDK (0.9.1) (422):
```py
# sample-app uses redwood.client v0.9.1
client.routes.create(name='onboard-test', model='gpt-open-3', timeout=30.0)
# no model_variant kwarg in autocomplete and passing extra kwargs raises TypeError
```

mara: ok this is two separate bugs: 1) SDK surface missing model_variant (server requires it for some models) and 2) retry/transport behavior causing duplicate POSTs. The python transport layer adds urllib3 Retry(policy) by default and will retry on certain 5xx which is unsafe for non-idempotent POSTs unless caller set Idempotency-Key.

aj: confirmed on my local: python client schema has RouteCreate = {name: str, model: str, timeout: float} — there is no model_variant field. Also it coerces timeout to float and serializes as 30.0 which backend accepts, but absence of model_variant triggers validation.

sam: the duplicate issue trace:
```
[2025-07-10T09:12:01Z] POST /v1/routes req_id=r_a1 - upstream 500
[2025-07-10T09:12:02Z] python-urllib3 retry -> POST /v1/routes req_id=r_b2
[2025-07-10T09:12:02Z] POST /v1/routes req_id=r_b2 - created
```
Customer saw two routes; no Idempotency-Key header present because SDK didn't surface header helper.

leo: short-term mitigations: 1) use raw REST curl from sample-app deploy (or client._transport.request with explicit headers), 2) pass explicit Idempotency-Key via client.default_headers or set transport.retries=0, 3) vendor a tiny shim in onboarding that adds model_variant to payload before calling sdk.create. example shim:
```py
payload = {"name": name, "model": model, "model_variant": 'v2', "timeout": int(timeout)}
client._transport.request('POST', '/v1/routes', json=payload, headers={'Idempotency-Key': uid()})
```

mara: I'll open a ticket with repro app link, exact sdk version, and a minimal failing test. we should: a) expose model_variant in RouteCreate for python sdk, b) accept both timeout (int seconds) and timeout_ms (int ms) where sensible, c) change default retry policy so POST is not retried unless caller opts-in with Idempotency-Key, and d) add integration test that compares SDK-serialized payload to canonical REST json.
devex-bot: Created DEVEX-4899: "python-sdk: expose model_variant on route create, normalize timeout param, and disable unsafe POST retry by default" — https://tickets.redwood/DEVEX-4899 :robot_face:

aj: I'll pick up the SDK change. plan: add model_variant optional str/enum, accept timeout or timeout_ms (normalize in client), and remove retries on non-idempotent methods at transport layer. will also add an explicit header helper for idempotency.
sam: thanks — attaching sample-app and test vectors to DEVEX-4899 now. tagging @leo to help with temporary ops alert to detect near-duplicate route creations (same payload within 2s).
mara: good call. i'll coordinate with eng-sre for the alert. will update the ticket with test results and a short README for onboarding teams (workaround until sdk patch lands). :thumbsup:
